about: The rules an asset is checked against, read by both the Models page (modeller/checks.js) and Python (townstudio/assets.py), so the two never disagree.

resident.why: World's residents are about 1.6 m tall, and walk as circles of 0.35 m (src/game.js NPC_RADIUS; the player is 0.28).

prop.about: something you hold or put on a shelf or table

furniture.about: seats, tables, beds, cabinets, machines people use indoors

fixture.about: fitted to a room or a street: counters, lamps, vending machines, poles

vehicle-part.about: parts of the ferry, a boat, a car

building-part.about: facades, roofs, stairs, whole small buildings

checks.label: Stands on the floor, nothing floating
Real size, sane next to a 1.6 m resident
Every part says what it is for
Seats and standing spots are clear
Room for the people who use it
Purpose: who it is for, why, where

brandsWhy: Real makers and shops a 1990s Japanese town would show. Words that are also ordinary words or names here are left out on purpose: the onsen's bandai (番台) counter, the Meiji era, Asahi as a street, surnames such as Honda, Suzuki or Toyota, and words like national, sharp, canon or apple.

body.world: nothing happens: it is what you see and bump into

seat.world: backs one of the card's seats (World seats people from the card's seats)

surface.is: a top things are put on
surface.world: props can be set down on it (a counter, a table top)

container.world: can be opened and looked into

handle.is: what a hand takes hold of
handle.world: where a resident's hand goes to open or carry it

button.world: pressing it starts or stops the asset

coin-slot.world: paying here starts the asset (the card's action price)

control.world: a resident can pick it up to work the asset

lamp.is: a light, LED or glowing panel
lamp.world: lights while the asset is powered and running

screen.world: shows something while powered (a timer, a picture)

motor.is: a part that moves under power (rollers, fan blades, a drum)
motor.world: moves while the asset is running

wheel.world: turns when the asset is pushed or driven

cord.world: leads to a socket; a room that wires the asset itself may hide it

sign.is: words or a picture meant to be read
sign.world: the player can read it; stories can quote it

decoration.is: trim that is only there to look right

rolesWhy: Parts are verbs (research/mario-artist/report.md §3): what a part is for tells World what it does and gives the storyteller something to write ("Fujita fed the chair a coin"). A part with no role, or a role not on this list, is refused. `now` says whether World already does what the role promises (studio-assets.js); the check names the roles World does not act on yet, so nobody expects them to work.
